properties.name: Healthy Eating
properties.activityTarget: Carbohydrates have the greatest impact on blood sugar. Work with a registered dietitian to determine the best nutrition plan for you. A Mediterranean Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) style diet may have additional benefits if you have or are at risk for high blood pressure. Dietary sodium should be limited to 1600–2300mg daily if you have diabetes and high blood pressure. A vegetarian style of eating may be helpful. Achieve balanced eating using the plate method (see Figure C-1).
properties.expectedBenefit: can help manage prediabetes, diabetes, and high blood pressure

properties.name: Physical Activity Recommendations for Most Adults with Diabetes
properties.activityTarget: 150 minutes or more of exercise, such as walking, per week. 2–3 sessions per week of resistance training. Flexibility training, such as tai chi, 2–3 times per week. Do not sit for more than 30 minutes at a time. No more than two days in a row without exercise.

detail: Monitoring your HbA1c, blood pressure, lipids, and kidney health is important. Keeping your numbers close to your target

properties.statement: Monitoring your HbA1c, blood pressure, lipids, and kidney health is important. Keeping your numbers close to your target range can help reduce your risk for diabetes complications. See Figure 1 for suggested target ranges for HbA1c and blood sugar. Use shared decision-making with your provider to identify your targets.
